[ASSISTANT_SAID] Defenders in rugby league coordinate tackles and manipulate the ball carrier to force turnovers through line speed, communication, tackle technique, ball strips, and interceptions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Line speed involves defenders sprinting up in a straight line to limit the ball carrier's time and space.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Communication among defenders includes shouting calls and directions to ensure everyone knows their roles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Proper tackle technique involves hitting the ball carrier low and wrapping arms around their legs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ball strips are executed by one defender holding the attacker while another rips the ball away.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Interceptions require defenders to read the game and anticipate passes.
